question: Anup Rag Vilas’ is a book written by which of the following musicians?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Kumar Gandharva**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva** is the author of the book "Anup Rag Vilas".
 
• He was a renowned Indian classical singer known for his unique style and innovative approach to Hindustani classical music.
 
• The book provides insights into his musical journey and contributions to the field of classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva**, born Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath, was born on 8 April 1924 and passed away on 12 January 1992.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1977 and the Padma Vibhushan in 1990, which are among India's highest civilian honors.
 
• His innovative approach often included incorporating elements from folk music into classical performances.
